references.text: Moses gave the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Describes the inheritance given to half the tribe of Manasseh, including the entire kingdom of Bashan under King Og.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, who was one of the Rephaites, and his territory that included all of Bashan.
Mentions the region of Argob and the kingdom of King Og in Bashan.
Og, king of Bashan, was the last remaining of the Rephaites, which explains why the land is called the land of the Rephaites.
Tells of Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, and the conquest of his land.
Mentions the Rephaites as a people group in the area, linked to the term 'land of the Rephaites'.
Half the tribe of Manasseh settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
